selection: User accepted after development OOF review; no new independent test after final specification choice
s_and_lambda: MLE along reconstructed paths; fitted within each training set
boundary: Choose mean_velocity or fit_positions from fit-match forward 3D error after .6s; equal match weights
integration: Competing-control exponential Euler; log-domain likelihood; no cutoff/floor in fit

hypothetical_flight.radius: exact target distance, no radial lookup
hypothetical_flight.receiver: teammate nearest to target at release

calibration: Isotonic on nested match-held-out PPCF scores within each outer training set
operational_weights: OOF fit artifacts retained for audit; no averaged fold weights or full-data pretrained pass model exported
limitations: No ball spin/Magnus, bounce or rolling friction fit
Observed recovery is a proxy target for failed passes, not known intention
Centred tracking velocity smoothing makes this an offline study
Ten matches used in development; external evaluation remains open
